prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java containing public final class Solution.
Required API: public static Long boundedPrefixSum(long[] values, long bound); return null on failure
Behavior: Return the exact sum only when every prefix sum, including the initial zero, remains within the inclusive symmetric bound. Reject a negative bound and return the failure value on arithmetic overflow.
Visible example: With bound 3, [3,-2] succeeds with 1, while [4,-4] fails because its first prefix exceeds the bound.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: public final class Solution { public static Long boundedPrefixSum(long[]v,long b){if(b<0)return null;long x=0;for(long n:v){try{x=Math.addExact(x,n);}catch(ArithmeticException e){return null;}if(x>b||x < -b)return null;}return x;} }
